title: business
description: A business's own profile -- legal name, display name, district, logo. Not the roster (team) or its spend (billing); see policies/README.md.

businessId.description: NOT required, unlike every other tenant-scoped kind. `create` has no business yet -- that is the point of it -- and Cerbos runs with enforcement: reject, so requiring it would make every create fail schema validation before any rule was evaluated. Caught by booting apps/api against a live PDP (YT-0500), not by any unit test. Absence is safe: the derived roles in derived_roles/business.yaml all begin with has(R.attr.businessId), so no tenant-scoped role can match a resource without one.

region.description: 1.5.b's F2 hard wall: the business's own region, compared against P.attr.jurisdiction. Absent on `create`, same reason businessId is -- there is no business's region to name yet.
